# uzc_blockstorage_attachment (Resource)

Attaches a UzCloud block storage volume to a virtual machine (POST /blockstorages/{slug}/attach and /detach). Manage the attachment either through this resource or through the `virtual_machine` field on uzc_blockstorage directly, never both for the same volume, or Terraform and the API will fight over the attachment on every apply. The resource ID is "{blockstorage_slug}:{virtual_machine_slug}".

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Manage the attachment either through this resource or through the
# `virtual_machine` field on uzc_blockstorage directly, never both for the
# same volume.
resource "uzc_blockstorage_attachment" "example" {
  blockstorage    = uzc_blockstorage.example.slug
  virtual_machine = uzc_virtual_machine.example.slug
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `blockstorage` (String) Slug of the uzc_blockstorage volume to attach.
- `virtual_machine` (String) Slug of the virtual machine to attach the volume to.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) "{blockstorage_slug}:{virtual_machine_slug}". Used for import.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import uzc_blockstorage_attachment.example <blockstorage-slug>:<virtual-machine-slug>
```
